content:
Another small update from me today. I have news! It's small news, but still, I hope the Bear Blog community can take this and use it.

I finally have a theme based on my blog in Bear Blog's theme directory!

It's called Low Vision Reader. Of course, it was made with low vision readers in mind by having large text by default, a relatively high contrast base, and more accessibility goodies.

Herman, the creator of Bear, had to make some tweaks to it so it would work best with Bear Blog, but it's up there!

I wanted to give the Bear community something since I read their discovery feed daily.

A while back, I hired Travis Jeans to make the theme. and the original repo is here, so go hire them!

I do like the changes Bear is making, though! Bear is making Blogging and hosting static sites easy and accessible to so many people that I point new people there often when they tell me they want to blog.

I especially enjoy finding the diamonds in the Most Recent portion of the Discovery feed.

Back to bed.

Until next time, everyone.
